name: Chloral betaine
summary: Sedative-hypnotic drug that was introduced into the United States in the 60's. Betaine complex with Chloral hydrate, thus makes it act as an extended version of Chloral hydrate then to Trichloroethanol, which is responsible for most of its effects.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It is a betaine complex of trimethylglycine with chloral hydrate, which acts as an extended-acting formulation of chloral hydrate which is then metabolized into trichloroethanol, which is responsible for most or all of its effects.

summaryZh: 氯醛甜菜鹼，是一種鎮靜催眠藥。1963年由美贊臣在美國推出。它是一種含有水合氯醛的甜菜鹼複合物，作為水合氯醛的長效製劑，然後代謝成三氯乙醇，三氯乙醇是其大部分或全部作用的原因。
summaryZhHans: 氯醛甜菜碱，是一种镇静催眠药。1963年由美赞臣在美国推出。它是一种含有水合氯醛的甜菜碱复合物，作为水合氯醛的长效制剂，然后代谢成三氯乙醇，三氯乙醇是其大部分或全部作用的原因。

uses.en: It was prescribed as a sleeping medicine and sedative. It is rarely used today.
uses.zh: 它曾被用作安眠藥與鎮靜劑，如今已很少使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被用作安眠药与镇静剂，如今已很少使用。

sideEffects.en: Effects are like those of chloral hydrate: drowsiness, dizziness, unsteadiness and stomach upset. Regular use can lead to dependence. Overdose can cause deep unconsciousness and dangerous heart rhythm problems and can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用與水合氯醛相似：嗜睡、頭暈、步態不穩與腸胃不適。規律使用可能導致依賴。過量可能造成深度昏迷與危險的心律不整，甚至致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用与水合氯醛相似：嗜睡、头晕、步态不稳与肠胃不适。规律使用可能导致依赖。过量可能造成深度昏迷与危险的心律不整，甚至致命。

fact.en: Its active part, chloral hydrate, was first made in 1832 by the German chemist Justus von Liebig, and in 1869 it became one of the first synthetic sleeping drugs.
fact.zh: 它的活性成分水合氯醛，在 1832 年由德國化學家尤斯圖斯·馮·李比希首次合成，並在 1869 年成為最早的人工合成安眠藥之一。
fact.zhHans: 它的活性成分水合氯醛，在 1832 年由德国化学家尤斯图斯·冯·李比希首次合成，并在 1869 年成为最早的人工合成安眠药之一。
